Aria (People Ops): Heads up — Noah in Data handed in resignation this morning. Last day 2026-06-20. Need COBRA window, HSA rollover steps, final pay timing, and laptop return logistics.
Noah Patel: Correct on last day. Happy to do KT week 6/15-6/19. Prefer courier pickup for laptop.
Benefits Bot: Auto: COBRA election window = 60 days from termination. Coverage typically continues to month end of last day. HSA funds stay with custodian; employee can transfer to personal HSA or keep current account. Link: https://benefits.example.com/cobra-hsa
Payroll: Payroll cutoff for June is 2026-06-12. With 6/20 last day, final payout (including approved PTO) will be processed on the next payroll run after confirmation of hours. Manager sign-off required by 6/14.
IT Desk: Opening ticket IT-6123 for hardware return. We'll schedule courier pickup on 6/22 and email a pre-paid label. We'll snapshot home directory before deprovision.
Aria (People Ops): Deprovision default = 24h after last day unless extension requested. @IT Desk please coordinate snapshot and token revocation timing.
IT Desk: Plan: rsync snapshot on 2026-06-21 02:00 UTC, revoke SSO/API tokens at 09:00 UTC 2026-06-21. We'll transfer ownership of repos and rotate any service keys.
Noah Patel: I'll DM my manager the KT docs and confirm PTO hours. Also interested in short-term consulting as 1099, if doable.
Aria (People Ops): Noted. We'll flag for Legal review for post-employment consulting; manager should submit scope + proposed rate.
Benefits Bot: Reminder: COBRA packet mailed within 14 days of processed termination; employee must return election form within 30 days to avoid coverage gap.
Payroll: Once manager confirms PTO by 6/14, final pay will be on the 6/30 run.
Aria (People Ops): Thanks — I'll update the offboard tracker with COBRA/HSA notes, IT ticket, and payroll deadlines. Anything else?
Noah Patel: Please confirm courier label when available. Thanks everyone.
